---
permalink: /llms.txt
sitemap: false
layout: null
# Plain-text summary of the site for AI tools (/llms.txt). Words in [square
# brackets] are filled in automatically: [site] = site title, [author] =
# author name, [store] = store name, [price] = a price, [condition] = item
# condition, [brand] = brand, [category] = category.
intro_selling: "[site] is run by [author]. It has two parts: used tech that [author] sells directly (checkout through AnyCart and Stripe), and affiliate deals at other stores."
intro: "[site] is run by [author]. It lists tech deals at other stores, each found and checked by hand."
website_label: Website
email_label: Email
pages_heading: Pages
# Page list: link text, then the short note after it.
home_label: Home
home_note_selling: newest items for sale and featured deals
home_note: featured deals
shop_label: For sale
shop_note: used tech sold directly, with condition notes
deals_label: Deals
deals_note: affiliate deals at other stores
blog_label: Blog
blog_note: tech deal guides and buying tips
about_label: About
about_note_selling: who runs the site and how buying works
about_note: who runs the site and how deals are picked
returns_label: Returns & shipping
returns_note: shipping times, returns, and refunds
disclosure_label: Affiliate disclosure
disclosure_note: how affiliate links on the Deals page work
terms_label: Terms
privacy_label: Privacy
for_sale_heading: For sale now
# One line per item for sale. [brand_part] = ", [brand]" when the item has a brand.
for_sale_line: "[price], [condition] condition[brand_part], [category]"
condition_default: used
deals_heading: Current deals (affiliate)
# One line per deal. deal_line_no_price is used for Amazon deals while
# amazon_show_prices is false; deal_was is added when there's an original price.
deal_line_no_price: "deal at [store] (see current price at [store])"
deal_line: "[price] at [store]"
deal_was: " (usually [price])"
faq_heading: FAQ
---
{%- comment -%}
  Plain-Markdown site summary for AI crawlers. Follows selling mode
  (site.selling, _plugins/selling_mode.rb): the shop, returns, and "for sale"
  parts only appear while at least one of my own items is for sale. Amazon deals
  list no price while amazon_show_prices is false (Associates rules).
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign for_sale = site.products | where: "type", "sale" | where: "status", "available" | sort: "date" | reverse -%}
{%- assign today = site.time | date: "%Y-%m-%d" -%}
{%- assign deals = site.products | where: "type", "affiliate" | sort: "date" | reverse -%}
# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip_html | strip_newlines | strip }}

{% if site.selling %}{% assign intro = page.intro_selling %}{% else %}{% assign intro = page.intro %}{% endif %}{{ intro | replace: "[site]", site.title | replace: "[author]", site.author }} {{ site.data.disclosures.affiliate | strip }}

- {{ page.website_label }}: {{ site.url }}/
{%- if site.data.company.email and site.data.company.email != "" %}
- {{ page.email_label }}: {{ site.data.company.email }}
{%- endif %}

## {{ page.pages_heading }}

{% if site.selling -%}
- [{{ page.home_label }}]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): {{ page.home_note_selling }}
- [{{ page.shop_label }}]({{ '/shop/' | absolute_url }}): {{ page.shop_note }}
{%- else -%}
- [{{ page.home_label }}]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): {{ page.home_note }}
{%- endif %}
- [{{ page.deals_label }}]({{ '/deals/' | absolute_url }}): {{ page.deals_note }}
- [{{ page.blog_label }}]({{ '/blog/' | absolute_url }}): {{ page.blog_note }}{% for post in site.posts %}
  - [{{ post.title }}]({{ post.url | absolute_url }}){% endfor %}
{%- for c in site.data.categories %}{% assign cat_live = 0 %}{% for d in deals %}{% if d.category == c.name %}{% if d.expires %}{% assign exp = d.expires | date: "%Y-%m-%d" %}{% if exp < today %}{% continue %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% assign cat_live = cat_live | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if cat_live > 0 %}
  - [{{ site.data.strings.category.heading | replace: "[category]", c.name }}]({{ '/deals/' | append: c.slug | append: '/' | absolute_url }})
{%- endif %}{% endfor %}
- [{{ page.about_label }}]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): {% if site.selling %}{{ page.about_note_selling }}{% else %}{{ page.about_note }}{% endif %}
{%- if site.selling %}
- [{{ page.returns_label }}]({{ '/returns/' | absolute_url }}): {{ page.returns_note }}
{%- endif %}
- [{{ page.disclosure_label }}]({{ '/disclosure/' | absolute_url }}): {{ page.disclosure_note }}
- [{{ page.terms_label }}]({{ '/terms/' | absolute_url }}) and [{{ page.privacy_label }}]({{ '/privacy/' | absolute_url }})
{% if site.selling %}
## {{ page.for_sale_heading }}
{% for p in for_sale %}
{%- capture price %}{% include money.html amount=p.price %}{% endcapture %}
{%- capture brand_part %}{% if p.brand %}, {{ p.brand }}{% endif %}{% endcapture %}
{%- assign condition = p.condition | default: page.condition_default | downcase %}
- [{{ p.title }}]({{ p.url | absolute_url }}): {{ page.for_sale_line | replace: "[price]", price | replace: "[condition]", condition | replace: "[brand_part]", brand_part | replace: "[category]", p.category }}
{%- endfor %}
{% endif %}
## {{ page.deals_heading }}
{% for p in deals %}
{%- if p.expires %}{% assign exp = p.expires | date: "%Y-%m-%d" %}{% if exp < today %}{% continue %}{% endif %}{% endif %}
{%- capture amz %}{% include amazon-hidden.html product=p %}{% endcapture %}
{%- capture price %}{% include money.html amount=p.price %}{% endcapture %}
{%- capture was %}{% if p.compare_at %}{% include money.html amount=p.compare_at %}{% endif %}{% endcapture %}
- [{{ p.title }}]({{ p.url | absolute_url }}): {% if amz != "" %}{{ page.deal_line_no_price | replace: "[store]", p.store }}{% else %}{{ page.deal_line | replace: "[price]", price | replace: "[store]", p.store }}{% if p.compare_at %}{{ page.deal_was | replace: "[price]", was }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
{%- endfor %}
{%- if site.data.faqs and site.data.faqs.size > 0 %}

## {{ page.faq_heading }}
{% for f in site.data.faqs %}
**{{ f.q | strip }}**
{{ f.a_plain | default: f.a | strip_html | strip }}
{% endfor %}
{%- endif %}
